title: senro stream end marker
description: The terminal NDJSON line GET /api/stream writes instead of merely closing the connection, whenever the server has more to say than a bare closed channel would communicate on its own. Deliberately NOT Event-shaped: a client recognises this line by the stream_end field alone, before ever attempting to decode it as an Event. CLOSED (additionalProperties is false), matching frame.schema.json's own reasoning: this line is point-to-point on one already version-negotiated connection, not a persisted, independently-read artifact like an event.

stream_end.description: Always true on this line. What distinguishes it from an ordinary event.

last_seq.description: The seq of the last event this connection actually delivered, 0 if none ever were. Do not derive a resume point by adding 1 to this when it is 0; use hint instead.

overflowed.description: Wire-compatibility field for a client built before reason existed. Prefer reason when present.

reason.description: Why the stream ended. Informative, not exhaustive: a client must decode an unrecognised value rather than fail on it.

hint.description: The server's own resume advice: GET /api/state for a fresh snapshot, then, if the run is not yet done, GET /api/stream?from=<state.seq+1>.
